ui.hundred_years_war.manual.automation.t:
[img|u=transport_workstation_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]Activated by a nearby §aPorter§r. You need to use §aTransport Order§r to set transport routes. §aTransport Order§r crafting:[img|u=transport_order_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0](Black dye can be replaced with any dye item, oak planks can be replaced with any wood planks)
Press §e[key|transport_action]§r to bind with workstation or add transport targets. Press §eRight-click§r to open UI and set detailed properties for each transport target. §aWithdraw§r means withdraw to the bound transport workstation, §aDeposit§r means deposit to the corresponding transport target. The bottom item row is the filter, you can specify items. If not specified, all items will be transported. The quantity input box represents withdraw/deposit up to this amount, set to 0 means all.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.automation.w: Warehouse is a special container with customizable capacity, composed of two types of blocks: Control Block and Storage Block. The Control Block is the main body of the warehouse, providing interaction functionality. Its crafting recipe is as follows (craft Transport Order first):[img|u=transport_order_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0](Black dye can be replaced with any dye item, oak planks can be replaced with any wood planks)[img|u=warehouse_control_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]The Control Block will render a warehouse range. Each Storage Block within the warehouse range can provide capacity to the warehouse. The crafting recipe for Storage Block is as follows:[img|u=warehouse_storage_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]Interact with the Control Block to open the warehouse interface and withdraw/deposit items. Transport Orders also need to set the Control Block as the target. Currently, only players and porters can interact with the warehouse.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.command.cont: 0Кликните 1 правой кнопкой мыши на объекте, чтобы переключить его состояние отслеживания .23Кроме того, мод предоставляет различные способы управления вашими солдатами. Нажмите на элементы слева, чтобы просмотреть соответствующий контент.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.command.pane:
The command wheel is a quick operation panel that can be opened at any time. §eLong press [key|command_wheel]§r to open it. [img|u=command_wheel.png|w=96|dx=45|dy=0]Hover a leaf action and release the wheel key to execute it immediately; clicking still works. Releasing over a submenu such as §eEdit Formation§r enters that submenu and keeps the wheel open without requiring the trigger to remain held. You can then left-click actions or continue into deeper sub-wheels. Press and release the original trigger again, left-click empty space, or right-click to close the wheel. If you entered a sub-wheel by clicking before the initial release, releasing over a leaf still executes it immediately. In RTS mode, hold §e[key|formation_toggle]§r, or hold §eMMB§r while carrying the Command Staff, to open the §eEdit Formation§r sub-wheel directly. This submenu can arrange selected units into an automatic square or line formation, dissolve selected formations, or set formation unit and subgroup spacing to 1x, 2x, or 4x. In RTS mode, right-drag can still create a formation with a custom frontage. §eSet Facing§r on the root wheel changes the facing of individual units or formations. The §arecruitment screen§r can be opened from the wheel or by §eright-clicking§r with the §aConqueror's Staff§r.
The wheel supports pagination and sub-wheels. Click the center button or use the §emouse wheel§r to flip pages. For sub-wheels, the first option returns to the previous level. [img|u=command_wheel_1.png|w=96|dx=45|dy=0]
In RTS mode, you can freely control the camera, select units, and issue commands. Press §e[key|freecam_toggle]§r to enter RTS mode.

Camera Control:
Hold §emiddle mouse+move keys§r to control camera flight (similar to creative/spectator mode). You can freely observe the entire battlefield or find a suitable command angle. Without holding §emiddle mouse§r, moving the mouse to the edge of the screen will also control the camera in 4 directions. Use the §emouse wheel§r to adjust flight speed.

Unit Command:
To issue commands to units, you need to select them first. Hold §eleft mouse button§r to box-select units. A single click selects one unit, while double-clicking (or §e[key|ctrl_mode]+click§r) selects every unit of the same type on screen. With units selected, hold §eright mouse§r and drag over the ground to preview and create a rectangular formation; drags below the minimum distance remain normal move commands.
After selecting units, their available actions and hotkeys appear in the bottom left (mouse actions appear in the bottom right). Press a hotkey to activate its action, then click a position when the action needs a target.

Queue Mode:
Hold §e[key|queue_mode]§r to issue multiple consecutive commands. To specify patrol points, first press §e[key|patrol_toggle]§r, then hold §e[key|queue_mode]§r and use §eleft-click§r on multiple positions.

Other Hotkeys:
Hold §e[key|formation_toggle]§r-Open Formation Wheel, §e[key|team_color_toggle]§r-Toggle Отряд Color Mode
§e[key|ctrl_mode]+Number Keys§r-Create Отряд, §eNumber Keys§r-Select Отряд
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.command.staf: Командный состав - это инструмент, специально предназначенный для командования войсками. Его рецепт крафта показан ниже:[img|u=command_staff_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]Командный состав подходит для игроков, которые не знакомы с операциями RTS или предпочитают ванильный стиль.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.recruit.cont:
There are currently 2 ways to obtain soldiers in survival mode.

Through the recruitment screen:
Hold §e[key|command_wheel]§r to open the command wheel and click the §eRecruitment§r button, or §eright-click§r while holding the §aConqueror's Staff§r, to open the recruitment screen. Use the §arace§r selector in the upper left first, then filter units by §acategory§r and the search boxes on the left. The middle list lets you expand a unit type into its available levels and adjust quantities. The right side shows a preview of the selected entry, its per-order time, XP cost, and required resources; clicking an entry also opens a more detailed description.

Clicking §eRecruit§r opens a confirmation page that summarizes every unit currently in the cart, together with the total time, total XP, and total resource cost. After confirming, a banner will appear at your position. The remaining time is shown above it, and units will muster near the banner one after another when preparation is complete.

Each order also adds a fixed 5-minute base preparation time. The exact unit time, XP, and material costs are the values shown in the screen.

Through loot:
Soldier scrolls can be found in villages, dungeon chests, and on some hostile mobs. Using a scroll directly grants the corresponding soldier.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.relation.con:
You can modify your §cone-way relationship§r with other objects in the relationship system. There are 4 types of relationships: §cHostile§r, §eNeutral§r, §eFriendly§r, §aControl§r.

Switching to Hostile means declaring war, and the other party's relationship with you will also change to §cHostile§r.
In a Neutral relationship, if units are killed or take multiple attacks in a short period, both parties' units will also become §cHostile§r.
Setting Friendly will treat the other party as allies, while Control shares §acontrol of units§r with the other party.

To adjust relationships with other players, click on the items on the left to view details.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.relation.per:
Press §e[key|freecam_toggle]§r to enter RTS mode, go to the menu in the upper right corner, and click the Relations button to open the personal relationship list. [img|u=relation_list.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]The buttons represent your current relationship with the other party. Click the button to switch between the 4 relationship types. After making adjustments, click Apply to make the changes take effect.

Note:
1. The color of the other party's name represents their relationship with you: §cred for Hostile§r, §eyellow for Neutral or Friendly§r, §agreen for Control§r.
2. When adjusting relationships with отряд objects, it is equivalent to adjusting personal relationships with all members of the other party.
3. When adjusting from Hostile to Neutral, there will be a §a30-second grace period§r, during which the relationship will not become Hostile even if the other party causes damage or kills.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.relation.tea:
The отряд system allows players to отряд up and adjust relationships in batches.[img|u=team_member_list.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]To join a отряд, click the join отряд button and submit an application to the corresponding отряд.[img|u=team_join_list.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]To create a отряд, click the create отряд button and enter a unique отряд name to create a отряд.
Only owners or administrators in the отряд can adjust the external relations of the entire отряд and accept join applications.[img|u=applicant_list.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]Note:
1. Each player can only join one отряд.
2. When there is only 1 person in the отряд, leaving the отряд will automatically disband the отряд.
3. Отряд members are friendly to each other by default.

ui.hundred_years_war.manual.supply.conte: Единицы должны потреблять точки снабжения для работы. Если они не получат припасы, отряды получат дебафф и начнут терять здоровье через определенное время. ui.hundred_years_war.manual.supply.playe: В командном колесе (§e[key|command_wheel]§r) найдите кнопку питания игрока и нажмите, чтобы открыть страницу питания игрока. Положите еду и нажмите кнопку конвертировать, чтобы превратить еду в точки снабжения.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.supply.suppl: Точка снабжения - это размещаемый блок, который предоставляет припасы соседним дружественным отрядам. Его рецепт крафта показан ниже:[img|u= supply_point_recipe.png|w=128|dx=30|dy=0]Взаимодействуйте с точкой снабжения, чтобы открыть ее пользовательский интерфейс. После размещения еды еда будет конвертирована в точки снабжения с определенной скоростью. Введите номер и нажмите кнопку ввода/вывода, чтобы перенести точки снабжения между точкой снабжения и игроком.

ui.hundred_years_war.manual.unit.content: Узнайте, как хранить единицы в вашем инвентаре или заменять и удалять их оборудование.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.unit.equip.c:
Hold matching equipment and §esneak + left-click§r an entity to replace it. Armor replaces its matching slot, while weapons usually still need to be the same type. Built-in equipment always belongs to the entity, so replacing it never drops the old item. Replacing non-built-in equipment usually drops the old item, but if the server disables equipment drops then no equipment will drop at all.

§eSneak + left-click with an empty hand§r first removes one non-built-in item if the entity has any. If it has none, the action toggles the built-in armor on or off instead. This toggle affects armor only, not weapons. When built-in armor is enabled, removing a non-built-in armor piece automatically restores the matching built-in armor piece.

Equipment durability is also managed: built-in equipment no longer loses durability from combat, while non-built-in equipment below §c10%§r remaining durability cannot be given to units. Combat can wear down non-built-in equipment, and units can slowly maintain it back up to at most §e50%§r durability if the server enables that feature. When a non-built-in item becomes too worn, the unit will stow it automatically until it has recovered enough to be used again. When you aim at a valid target, a hint for the current equipment action is also shown below the crosshair.
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.unit.pack.co:
§eПрокрасться + правая кнопка мыши§r на отряде, чтобы сохранить его как свиток в своем инвентаре. §eЩелкните правой кнопкой мыши§r с помощью свитка, чтобы снова развернуть отряд.

Важные примечания:
При развертывании отряда из свитка право собственности перейдет к вам. §eВ режиме творчества вы можете нажать горячую клавишу выравнивания призыва (§e[key|summon_relation_toggle]§r§e), удерживая свиток или посох завоевателя, чтобы переключить, являются ли вновь призванные отряды дружественными (принадлежащими) или враждебными (не принадлежащими).§r
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.unit.title: Управление юнитами
ui.hundred_years_war.manual.unit.unstuck:
Units sometimes get stuck in mines or crevices. You can use teleportation to unstick them. Units will teleport in two situations:

1. Following players when entering the teleport distance range. This means once a unit's distance from the player is within this range, the unit will immediately teleport near the player. §eSince this is a range, having very distant units follow the player will not trigger teleportation.§r
To unstick, command the unit to follow the player, then move some distance away, and the unit will be teleported out.

2. Formation rally teleportation during formation movement. After issuing a formation movement command, troops will first slow down to form the formation, and resume speed once all units reach their positions. §eFormation formation has a time limit, and the more units in the formation, the longer the time limit. If the time limit is reached and there are still entities not in formation, it checks whether the number of rallied entities reaches three-quarters of the total. If so, all unrallied entities will be teleported to the nearest rallied entity.§r To unstick, issue a formation movement command nearby and wait for entities to rally.
